name: Collatz lifecycle controller
description: Durable packet receipts and bounded OpenClaw agent execution.

repoPath.description: Absolute path of the canonical Git checkout.

stateDir.description: Absolute external directory for durable lifecycle state.

packetPrefix.description: Stable prefix used with the OpenClaw session key for packet IDs.

enforcementMode.description: Observe records controller failures; enforce blocks a run or tool call.

receiptToolNames.description: Tool names whose calls create durable external-effect receipts.
